// CASE inorder_destructured_released_form expect=pass
export async function inOrder<T>(items: Iterable<T>, step: (item: T) => Promise<void>, { reason }: { reason: string }): Promise<void> {
  for (const item of items) {
    await step(item);
  }
}

// CASE inorder_interface_alias expect=pass
interface StepsOptions {
  reason: string;
}
export async function inOrderSteps(steps: Array<() => Promise<void>>, options: StepsOptions): Promise<void> {
  for (const step of steps) {
    await step();
  }
}
